 Robert Morris vs A rkansas Prediction 
 Robert Morris has shown no offense here through two games, and those contests came against UIC and Nevada. I doubt things improve when the comeptiion picks up agaisnt Arkansas. While it’s just two games, Robert Morris is one of the worst offensive teams in college basketball. Robert Morris is 362nd in points per game, 356th in field goal percentage, and 325th in three-point percentage. It’s all bad.
 This is also a bounce-back spot for Arkansas after a disappointing showing against Virginia. You know the guys will be ready after coming up small in a big game. Robert Morris will just catch the brunt of that frustration. This is another college game on Wednesday that has the potential to get ugly. Robert Morris doesn’t have the offensive horses to keep up. I’ll lay the points with Arkansas.
 Robert Morris Colonials Betting Preview
 The Robert Morris Colonials lost to Nevada and UIC, and they play Toledo next. Robert Morris has lost 3 straight games. Robert Morris is 0-2 SU on the road, 0-0 SU at home, and 0-2 ATS on the season.
 The Robert Morris Colonials are averaging 52.5 points per game on 33 percent shooting and allowing 82.5 points per game on 47.7 percent shooting. KJ Garris Jr. is averaging 13.5 points and 4 rebounds per game. Jalik Dunkley is averaging 8 points and 2 rebounds per game. Ta’Zir Smith is averaging 7.5 points and 1.5 rebounds. Darius Livingston is averaging 6.5 points and 1 assist per game. The Robert Morris Colonials are shooting 26.2 percent from beyond the arc and 83.3 percent from the free-throw line. The Robert Morris Colonials are allowing 36.2 percent shooting from deep and are grabbing 25.5 rebounds per game.
 Arkansas Razorbacks Betting Preview
 The Arkansas Razorbacks beat Arkansas-Pine Bluff, lost to Virginia, and they play Central Arkansas next. Arkansas has won 8 of its last 10 games. Arkansas is 0-0 SU on the road, 1-0 SU at home, and 1-1 ATS on the season.
 The Arkansas Razorbacks are averaging 89 points per game on 50.4 percent shooting and allowing 76 points per game on 43.1 percent shooting. Jordan Smith Jr. is averaging 19.5 points and 3 rebounds per game. Jeremiah Wilkinson is averaging 17 points and 2 assists per game. Mikka Muurinen is averaging 11 points and 1.5 assists per game. Abdou Toure is averaging 11 points and 2.5 rebounds per game. The Arkansas Razorbacks are shooting 35.1 percent from beyond the arc and 68.3 percent from the free-throw line. The Arkansas Razorbacks are allowing 34 percent shooting from deep and are grabbing 35.5 rebounds per game.
